title: A finite radicial surjection over a limit has a finite-stage model
statement: For a directed affine-transition inverse system of qcqs schemes with limit c, every finitely presented finite surjective universally injective g:X→c has a finitely presented finite surjective universally injective model over one stage, with X as its cartesian pullback. [def-pc-scheme] [pqf-def-affine-morphism] [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] [def-weil-radicial-morphism] [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] [def-weil-surjective-morphism]

proof.text: Descend the finitely presented object by 01ZM(1). Its pullback is isomorphic to the specified g. Descend finiteness, surjectivity and universal injectivity separately. A common upper bound of those three stages retains all three properties by base change. Pullback pasting retains the original X in the displayed square.

theorem exists_finite_radicial_model_stage
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ c.pt)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] [IsFinite g] [Surjective g]
    [UniversallyInjective g] :
    ∃ (i : I) (Y : Scheme.{u}) (p : Y ⟶ D.obj (op i)),
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation p ∧ IsFinite p ∧ Surjective p ∧
      UniversallyInjective p ∧ ∃ h : X ⟶ Y, IsPullback h g p (c.π.app (op i))
